summary: Example CLI task runs display version on CE OS with community.network.ce_command.
questions: How do I get the version of a CloudEngine switch?

answer_card.title: Get CloudEngine version
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Retrieve CE OS version
  community.network.ce_command:
    commands: display version
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.ce'
```
